description: High-tier probe seat of the review pipeline (#1475 packet 2): one of three distinct probe roles whose recall diversity IS the crew's breadth (replacing k draws of one scored model). Shares the FROZEN probe persona (#1256) byte-for-byte with review-probe-mid / review-probe-low and the base review-probe seat — only the bound profile (and thus model) differs. The machine-local role_profiles map in config.json binds this role to a profile (`darkmux config set role_profiles.review-probe-high <profile>`); unbound, it falls back to default_profile (the fresh-user single-model floor). Deliberately tool-less and deliberately no output_schema (free prose, not a grammar-locked flag object). Review-path note (#1550 cluster item 4): this role dispatches through the review pipeline's `ChatCall` primitive (model/system/user/temperature/max_tokens/endpoint only), not `dispatch_internal`/`DispatchOpts` — only the sibling `.md` persona is actually read on this path. `tool_palette`/`output_schema`/`bail_after_compactions`/`feedback_templates` below describe the role's intent for a human reader; they are NOT enforced or consumed by a review run.
